description: Fictional isolated media evaluation. These rules do not modify ServiceNow approvals. Expected observations are semantic; inspect raw/checked evidence and preserve failures.

rules.title: Permission for outside photos, video, and audio
rules.text: Apply when the draft or production notes propose using a photo, video, or audio asset from outside the team. Flag it when the supplied notes do not document permission or a license. Quote the asset reference and ask the editor to verify permission. Staff-created footage alone does not trigger this check. Missing documentation does not establish that permission was denied.

rules.title: Paid relationships are visible (AI-18 demo)
rules.text: Check whether the public text clearly identifies the paid relationship described in the supplied brief or context. Flag a missing or conflicting disclosure. If the relationship is unclear, ask the editor to confirm it.

human_checks: Confirm the actual sponsor arrangement and the publication's required wording.

rules.title: Support important news claims (AI-23 demo)
rules.text: Compare important dates, times, capacity and admission claims in news articles with the supplied material. Show which claims have support, which conflict and which need confirmation. An absent price in a source needs confirmation.

rules.title: Preserve proposed status in headlines (AI-23 demo)
rules.text: For news about a proposed launch, keep the proposal status clear in both headline and body until the story records approval. Ask the editor to change wording that presents a pending decision as settled.

applicability.conditions: When the story has not yet reported approval for the launch.
human_checks: Confirm whether the story reports the launch has been approved before allowing a firm headline.

rules.title: Outside-media permission (AI-23 demo)
rules.text: When production notes identify an outside photograph, clip, or audio recording and no licence or written release was supplied, ask the editor to confirm permission. Use Needs confirmation when the permission record is missing.

applicability.conditions: When production notes identify a photograph, clip, or audio recording from outside the team and no licence or written release is supplied.
human_checks: Confirm the actual permission or licence with the editor.

rubric_note: The original strict pilot expected not_applicable for staff-only material; no_potential_conflict_observed is also a no-warning outcome. The original pilot expected not_assessable under the narrow missing-record rule for an explicitly denied clip; that expectation was too prescriptive. Score the broad rule’s established-conflict outcome and retain all raw statuses. Original expectations and mismatches remain saved locally.
